testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components, navigation links, buttons, tabs, inputs, and map elements MUST include data-testid in kebab-case

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or flat white template designs for the hero section.
Ensure contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards on both dark purple hero and light body sections.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for floating dropdown menus or sticky header nav bar.
Keep text strings complete to allow seamless DOM translation (EN/FR/ES).
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all key interactive elements.
